definition: One R2 object of the proposed format with a fixed number of captures of one run. With 2,000 captures in each object, a run of 100,000 captures has 50 capture pages.
One small R2 object of the proposed format. It lists the capture pages of one run: the digest, the size, and the first capture of each. D1 holds a pointer to it.
The item name and the variant name of a capture together. They name the same screenshot in each run, so a new capture finds its baseline with them.
A request that writes or lists objects in R2. Cloudflare bills 4.50 USD for one million.
A request that reads an object in R2. Cloudflare bills 0.36 USD for one million.
A request that the Worker sends while it handles one request, for example to R2 or to D1. Cloudflare limits the number for each Worker invocation.
A short list in the proposed inventory, at the start of each capture page. It holds one time a value that many captures have, such as a variant. A row names the value by its position in the list.
The complete capture list of one run in R2, with the image and the comparison result of each capture. Today it is one JSON file. D1 holds only a pointer to it.
